_note: Casters are the caster and support archetypes (phase 3b, Decision 1): Cinder Moth and Gloam Witch in Act 1. The payoff (round 2): its own hits on them deal 20% more. Phase 5c step 6c: ranks (+35%; then its first hit on each Silences it 1s), and any hero takes it.
name: Casters first
text: Goes for the nearest enemy caster or support first, and hits them harder; with none standing, picks as usual.

_note: Lets go for good (phase 3b, Decision 2). The payoff (round 2): its attack runs 20% faster while it holds. Phase 5c step 6c: ranks (+35%; then half of it stays after letting go).
name: Hold your ground
text: Stays where it's placed, attacking faster at whatever is in reach, until an enemy comes within 2 hexes; then it moves out for the rest of the fight.

_note: The bar waits, full (phase 3b, Decision 3), until an ally is below 60% (Decision 5). Only a mana signature that heals the lowest ally can wait: Vell's Mend (Decision 4). The payoff (round 2): the heal it waited for is 15% stronger (R4 tuned it from 30%). Phase 5c step 6c: any hero with a healing signature; ranks (+25% at 70%; then it cleanses one harmful status).
name: Wait to heal
text: Holds the healing signature, its bar full, until an ally in its reach is badly hurt; the heal it saved is stronger.

_note: Phase 5 (part 6's example): stops walking while an enemy stands within 2 hexes, so a ranged hero keeps its distance and a melee one holds a line; closes in again when none does. Phase 5c step 6c (loadout/tactics.md): its payoff, +10 DEF while stopped (+20; then +10% ATK and MGK too).
name: Plant your feet
text: Stops walking while an enemy stands within 2 hexes, fighting whatever is in reach; closes in again when none is that near.

name: Fliers first
text: Goes for the nearest flying enemy first, and hits fliers harder; with none standing, picks as usual.

name: Marked first
text: Goes for the nearest Marked enemy first, and crits them more often; with none Marked, picks as usual.

name: Finish them
text: Goes for the enemy lowest on HP within its reach, and hits enemies near death harder.

name: Break the line
text: Goes for the enemy with the most DEF first, and its hits on its target ignore part of its DEF.

name: Guard the weakest
text: Goes for whoever is attacking its ally lowest on HP, and is tougher while it does.

name: Keep your distance
text: Backs away between attacks to keep its target at the edge of its reach, attacking faster from there.

name: Stay with the tank
text: Stays within 2 hexes of its ally with the most DEF, and is tougher while it does.

name: Dive
text: Goes for the farthest enemy, past the front line, hitting harder for the first few seconds.

name: Wait for a crowd
text: Holds an area signature, its bar full, until 3 enemies stand in its area (or every enemy left), a few seconds at most; then it hits harder.

name: Save it for the kill
text: Holds a damaging signature, its bar full, until its target is below half HP; then it hits harder.
